prompt:

Image 1 is the scene to revise. Image 2 is the selected approved style reference and is the authority for rendering: broad smooth solid matte color planes, confident thick dark outer contours, economical cartoon faces, simple blocky forms. Do not copy the people, burning village, flag or scenery from image 2.
Two targeted corrections:
1. REDRAW, not blur, every high-frequency mottled surface in image 1 into broad quiet forms. Replace the scratches and many tiny fabric stains with at most two or three smooth solid tonal planes on each garment. Render faces and hands as readable chunky cartoon planes, retaining each separate ordinary adult human identity and their worried/uncertain dignity. Replace tiny ground clods/grass speckles with broad clean tan soil banks and a few large grouped patches. Simplify rocks, trench walls, wooden posts, distant hills and clouds into a small number of confident shapes. Name tokens remain large clear plain wood rectangles. Make the illustration match image 2's clean broad chunky matte mobile-game readability, not etched book illustration, detailed watercolor, realistic painting or grainy grunge. No texture overlays and no softened blur.
2. The background must have EXACTLY THREE separate old church extraction structures total: two narrow pale tapering stone pylons visibly fractured/broken down, and one matching pylon collapsed into a distinct low rubble pile with a fallen long stone section. All inactive and unlit. They are modest extraction obelisks, not castle watchtowers: remove ALL roofs, crenellations and extra tower silhouettes. Space the three remains across the upper-right distance, with no fourth structure.
Keep the core No-Banner as SIX distinct ordinary human memory faces/shoulders with different hair/helmets/hoods, overlapping torn cloth and separate wooden name tags; no skulls, skeletons, evil glow, monster, ghost king, dominant boss, united army or one shared giant body. Preserve the two smaller human echoes already leaving to either side, the open winding path between nameless burial trenches, the torn scraps of differently colored old flags, the open register and spare tags on the foreground stone. No complete flags, named living heroes or new people. Echo nature comes from absent cloth sections and silhouette gaps rather than flashy magic. Preserve muted slate gray, earth brown, ocher tag accents and daylight. Full-width scene, not a cutout or cropped portrait. The character cluster remains centered and legible at 256×144.
No lettering, labels, UI, border, watermark, signature, readable runes, neon smoke or new props. This is an intentionally opaque scene plate. Preserve all story semantics except the explicitly corrected tower count, and retain the whole authored wide scene.
